interpretation.supported: AQ3 movie attention is more diffuse and assigns less mass to the five most recent events than AQ0 under the rejected Attention-20 checkpoint.
interpretation.not_supported: This observational diagnostic does not establish that diffuse attention causes the AQ0-AQ3 gap, nor does it justify deleting older history.
interpretation.next_hypothesis: A future single-variable candidate may retain both time scales while learning an explicit recent-versus-older fusion, then face the unchanged five Validation gates.
